rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
rules.requirement: This act prohibits the use of algorithmic rent setting in the rental housing market in Massachusetts.
rules.summary_plain: In Massachusetts, landlords are prohibited from using algorithms to set rent prices.
rules.summary_plain_es: En Massachusetts, los propietarios tienen prohibido usar algoritmos para establecer los precios de alquiler.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all rental housing in Massachusetts.
rules.quoted_span: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
